eruruu_patch.viewer.bonemeal_surface: Apply Bone Meal to a Grass Block. Every new Short Grass created by the spread has an 8% chance to become a Farmer's Delight wild crop; remaining new Short Grass also has a 3% chance to become a Sweet Berry Bush.
eruruu_patch.viewer.bonemeal_rice: Apply Bone Meal to Dirt under one block of shallow source water. Every new Seagrass created by the spread has an 8% chance to become Wild Rice.
eruruu_patch.viewer.fertilizer: Use Fertilizer on Dirt to replace it with a Grass Block.
eruruu_patch.viewer.endless_charcoal: Combine 64 Charcoal in a Crafting Table. Burns for 2,147,483,647 ticks.
eruruu_patch.viewer.mushroom_room: Use Bone Meal on Dirt in a dark two-block-high room (light 7 or less) with a full ceiling and source water directly above it. Each valid attempt consumes Bone Meal; 10% total chance, split evenly between Brown and Red Mushrooms.
eruruu_patch.viewer.nylium_culture: Use the culture on Netherrack to convert the block into the matching Nylium.
fml.menu.mods.info.description.eruruu_pa: OneBlock compatibility and quality-of-life patch made for Eruruu's Cult. Adds renewable resource routes, Fertilizer, Endless Charcoal, starter mushrooms, Nether cultures, extra mob loot, and JEI/EMI documentation. Includes reinforced AFK pickaxes with additive durability and Sugar Rush foods for long AFK mining sessions.
eruruu_patch.viewer.moss_helmet: Wear the Moss Helmet to unlock moss interactions: Bone Meal on Cobblestone converts it to Moss and triggers the normal Moss bonemeal spread; use a Hoe on a Moss Block to turn it into Dirt.
commands.eruruu_patch.givepick.blacklist: %s is excluded from THE Pick reinforcement.
commands.eruruu_patch.givepick.invalid_p: %s cannot be used as a reinforced pickaxe base.
gui.eruruu_patch.filtered_hopper.filter_: Insert one item. Only matching Item IDs may enter.
eruruu_patch.viewer.filtered_hopper: The Filtered Hopper has five normal storage slots and one dedicated filter slot. Place one item in the filter slot to allow only that Item ID to enter. Damage, names, enchantments and other components do not affect matching. The filter item is not consumed, outgoing items are never restricted, and automation cannot access or change the filter slot.
